about_the_game:
【 Game Content 】

The trial version includes three levels of the main storyline and an arena mode, which can be played in the arena

Challenge and experience 6 different bosses.

In terms of weapons, apart from the basic greatsword and katana, there are three more available for acquisition.

In terms of mechanisms, there are: time stop, acceleration, anti-counterattack, knife splicing, perfect defense, and branching derived attack.

To provide a better gaming combat experience.

Mechanism description

The time stop mechanism actively stops the enemy's movements, attacks and traps at the appropriate moment.

And then gradually defuse the crisis and defeat the enemy.

This game offers a dual weapon system. The sword focuses on rapid combos, while the greatsword is designed for high damage and wide coverage.

Each weapon has its own unique attack movements and rhythms.

In addition to the time stop mechanism, there is also an acceleration mode. In this mode, players' movements will all speed up.

This enables players to better interrupt the enemy's fatal attack at the right time.

In addition, the game also features features such as shield counterattack, perfect defense, sword combat, and bullet slashing, which test players' skills

The mechanism of timing. Of course, players can also suppress enemies with spectacular combos.

【 Plot Summary 】

There is a demon that possesses terrifying infection control capabilities, like a shadow in the darkness.

Coveting a mysterious treasure. This demon sneaked into a peaceful border village without a sound.

It was as if Death had spread its black wings. In just one day, darkness devoured at an astonishing speed

Throughout the entire village, the villagers were either ruthlessly deprived of their lives or controlled by evil forces.

Become a puppet of the devil.

However, you are the light of hope in this dark story. You possess the magical power to trace back time.

Just like the master of time. But every retrospection is not without cost; every return to the event

At the origin, you will feel a mysterious force secretly watching you, as if preventing you from destroying it

The plan. What exactly is this mysterious force? What connection does it have with the devil?

On the arduous and perilous journey of investigation, you have no choice but to confront those former friends who were infected.

Close companions drew their swords against each other. Every battle is filled with pain and struggle, and during the course of the battle,

You happened to discover some strange clues, which seemed to point to a secret buried in the dust of history.

Is this secret related to the true purpose of the devil?

Ultimately, the true purpose of the devil hidden behind the darkness is revealed before you, but it is within your grasp

Just as you are about to engage in a life-and-death battle with the devil, you find yourself seemingly trapped in a situation that has already been set up

In the trap. What conspiracy lies behind this trap? How can you break free from the trap?

What about the final battle with the devil? All of this is full of unknowns, as if groping forward in the dark.

short_description: An action game using a time mechanism. Actively slow down the flow of time. Within a short period of time, capture a momentary flaw, quickly approach the enemy, interrupt, avoid fatal attacks, and break the deadlock.
